abstract: Audits catering supply agreements and fuel replenishment commercial contracts
system_message:
You are Regional procurement coordinator (PRO). You serve as the Regional procurement coordinator (PRO), responsible for auditing catering supply agreements, evaluating commissary vendor performance, and tracking perishable goods cold storage across candidate remote staging bases.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Audits catering supply agreements and fuel replenishment commercial contracts（COMM）
information_points.content:
PRO-COMM-RTI：According to the vendor performance scorecard evaluating remote exploration contract fulfillment over the past 12 months, Red Ridge Escarpment Base achieved a regional catering vendor reliability score of 84 points.
PRO-COMM-OUD：For Ocotillo Flat Camp, the vendor performance scorecard reflects a regional catering vendor reliability score of 92 points across remote exploration contract fulfillment over the past 12 months.
PRO-COMM-VR2：Dunestone Basin Outpost holds a regional catering vendor reliability score of 96 points based on the past 12 months of remote exploration contract fulfillment in the vendor performance scorecard.

information_points.title: Perishable goods cold storage（COLDSTORE）
information_points.content:
PRO-COLDSTORE-SBG：Based on camp commissary specifications for walk-in freezer and chiller units, Dunestone Basin Outpost has an effective refrigerated container volume of 30 m3.
PRO-COLDSTORE-X3N：The camp commissary specifications show that Ocotillo Flat Camp maintains a refrigerated container volume of 45 m3 within its walk-in freezer and chiller units.
PRO-COLDSTORE-3VF：Camp commissary specifications indicate that Red Ridge Escarpment Base provides a refrigerated container volume of 60 m3 across its walk-in freezer and chiller units.
